_doc: Narration for Endless Destiny. Each section starts at `at` (seconds) and must finish before `end`. Lines run in order; `gap` is silence after the line. A line with its own `at` is pinned to that time. `soft` lines are whispered quieter.

sections.name: I · The Void
lines: No sound. No shape. No direction.
And a question... older than the stars.

sections.name: II · A Point of Light
lines: Every journey begins smaller than a heartbeat.
One point of light. So small... the dark does not even notice it.
It does not know how far it will travel.
It does not know what it will become.
But the dark is wrong about it.
The dark is always wrong... about the small things.

sections.name: III · Inside the Light
lines: The same pattern. Repeating. Reaching. Refusing to stop.
Every ending you have ever feared... was only a door you could not yet see.
You were never meant to find the edge of it.

sections.name: IV · The Road
lines: They told you destiny was a destination.
One final place to stand... and call it the end.
Every road you walk... bends toward another.
Some paths vanish into the dark.
And some... begin exactly where the last one ended.

sections.name: V · Transformations
lines: The horizon... a single line of fire.
The line becomes a map of the stars.
The stars close into a circle...
and the circle breaks open... into a road.

sections.name: VI · Traces
lines: Every choice you have ever made. Every step. Every fall. Every time you got back up...
left a trace of light behind you.
And now... slowly... the traces begin to take shape.

sections.name: VII · Gravity
lines: It has been forming since the very first spark.
Every path. Every ending. Every return.
Pulled together by a gravity you cannot see...
Step back. See how small it is... against everything.
Closer than you have ever been.

sections.name: VIII · Through the Particle
lines: Through the smallest light... into the largest dark.
The same destiny... wearing a different face.

sections.name: IX · The Tunnel
lines: Every fear you carried. Every door you never opened.

sections.name: X · Collapse
lines: the world begins to pull inward.
There is nowhere left to run...

sections.name: XIII · The Road Beyond
lines: The ending... was only the beginning of another road.
